'''Barimoq Industries''' was a [[Tasari]]-run corporation that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tasariq]]. It produced a variety of personal [[Slugthrower/Legends|projectile weapons]], including the [[Protector (revolver)|Protector]].<ref name="J15" />
